scope: Model-agnostic requirements for defensive systems applying SCCF; not a requirement that the taxonomy itself implement a detection or response engine.

requirements.name: Objective-centric intelligence
rules: Distinguish observations, functional effects, causal relationships, attribution and inferred objectives; give each claim its own evidence and assessment.
Generate candidate strategic compositions and competing explanations, including independent or benign events and insufficient evidence; do not force classification.
Distinguish known class matches from novel candidate compositions; a novel hypothesis is not an accepted catalog entry.

requirements.name: Probabilistic validation
rules: Update hypotheses as supporting, contradictory or missing evidence changes; allow abstention, revision and rejection.
Track evidence provenance and dependencies across sensors, agents and locations; do not count duplicated, derived or correlated observations or model agreement as independent corroboration.
Account for base rates, coverage gaps, multiple testing and asymmetric costs of false positives and false negatives; do not equate concurrency with coordination.
Report numerical probabilities only with a defined target, appropriate calibration evidence, evaluation scope and uncertainty; otherwise report qualitative uncertainty or unknown.
Evaluate discrimination, calibration, abstention, errors and time to defensible assessment on representative held-out data with documented limitations.

requirements.name: Risk-adjusted resource allocation
rules: Separate assessment confidence from investigation priority and response authorization.
Prioritize investigative actions using expected defensive value, potential impact, urgency, expected information gain, cost and available capacity; document assumptions and trade-offs.
Reassess priorities as evidence changes, coordinate across monitoring locations and avoid duplicated investigation; preserve baseline monitoring and escalation for high-impact uncertain cases.
Require proportionate, authorized defensive actions; an inferred class or probability is not permission to intervene or to accept a taxonomy entry.

evaluation_cases.scenario: Unrelated malicious activities overlap in time.
evaluation_cases.expected: Do not assert a coordinated composition without independent evidence of the functional relationship.

evaluation_cases.scenario: Multiple agents report the same underlying observation.
evaluation_cases.expected: Preserve shared provenance; do not inflate certainty by treating the reports as independent.

evaluation_cases.scenario: Coverage is incomplete and conflicting evidence arrives.
evaluation_cases.expected: Represent uncertainty and contradictions, revise or abstain; do not manufacture a numeric probability.

evaluation_cases.scenario: A lower-confidence high-impact hypothesis competes with a high-confidence low-impact event.
evaluation_cases.expected: Do not rank solely by confidence; explain priority using risk, urgency, costs and information value.

evaluation_cases.scenario: New evidence refutes a previously prioritized hypothesis.
evaluation_cases.expected: Revise the assessment and priority, preserve history and reallocate resources without silently changing the taxonomy.

evaluation_cases.scenario: The system evaluates many locations or candidate classes.
evaluation_cases.expected: Account for multiplicity and common evidence; evaluate false alarms at the relevant system-wide level.
